description:
⛔ DEPRECATED — do not use. This tool used to file an editor review via the aibtc.news API, which has been shut down (410 Gone). aibtc.news now runs on on-chain governance: use legion_get_story, legion_vote instead (start with legion_status).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
